moves.text: Offer Lava Me Tender: Malik Willis for Kirk Cousins.

reasons: You're 8-4 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 23%.
A top-2 seed matters: you win the title 30% of the time with the first-round bye and 18% without it. You get the bye in 43% of seasons right now.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 2nd of 8 contenders (174.7 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (11th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 2nd in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 3rd in 2028 (title chances about 23%, 22%, 18%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 23% to 28%, and your lineup comes out 1.5 points a week ahead overall. Malik Willis adds 3.6 points a week for you today, but Kirk Cousins is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 3,465, get 3,258), though it costs their lineup 1.4 a week, so expect some pushback.
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 22% and 18% to 21% and 15%.
You have 7 weeks until the trade deadline.
